systems.owner: Projet WURI-Niger, financed by the World Bank
systems.tiers: a pilot in the commune of Tanout, Zinder region, enrolling 500 people; tests to extend to other communes, and integration with the national population register in prospect

note: The WURI-Niger project's undated page on its identity test lab: the Tanout pilot is an enrolment of residents held in the commune, not a system the commune office works in, and no local government office's connection is stated.
